name: graph_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE graph_meta(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), value TEXT NOT NULL)

name: graph_stop
sql: CREATE TABLE graph_stop(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, lat REAL, lon REAL)

name: pattern
sql:
CREATE TABLE pattern(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, route_id TEXT, code TEXT, direction TEXT,
      headsign TEXT, shape_id TEXT, stops TEXT, geometry TEXT, projections TEXT)

name: timetable
sql:
CREATE TABLE timetable(trip_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, pattern_id INTEGER, service_id TEXT,
      times TEXT, frequencies TEXT)

name: ride_edge
sql:
CREATE TABLE ride_edge(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, origin TEXT, destination TEXT,
      pattern_id INTEGER, boarding_index INTEGER, alighting_index INTEGER,
      distance_meters REAL, min_ride_seconds REAL CHECK(min_ride_seconds>=0),
      UNIQUE(pattern_id,boarding_index,alighting_index))

name: walk_edge
sql:
CREATE TABLE walk_edge(origin TEXT, destination TEXT, air_meters REAL,
      distance_meters REAL, seconds REAL, geometry TEXT, source TEXT, checked_at TEXT,
      status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','verified','unavailable','over_limit')),
      PRIMARY KEY(origin,destination))

name: candidate_cache
sql:
CREATE TABLE candidate_cache(origin TEXT, destination TEXT, transfers INTEGER,
      revision INTEGER, complete INTEGER, candidates TEXT,
      PRIMARY KEY(origin,destination,transfers))

name: calendar
sql: CREATE TABLE calendar (service_id TEXT,monday TEXT,tuesday TEXT,wednesday TEXT,thursday TEXT,friday TEXT,saturday TEXT,sunday TEXT,start_date TEXT,end_date TEXT)

name: calendar_dates
sql: CREATE TABLE calendar_dates (service_id TEXT,date TEXT,exception_type TEXT)

name: connection_pairs
sql:
CREATE TABLE connection_pairs (
            origin TEXT, destination TEXT, revision INTEGER, version INTEGER,
            complete INTEGER, built_at TEXT, stats TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(origin,destination))

name: connections
sql:
CREATE TABLE connections (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, origin TEXT, destination TEXT, boardings INTEGER,
            rank INTEGER, distance_meters REAL NOT NULL, bus_meters REAL NOT NULL,
            walk_meters REAL NOT NULL, walk_seconds REAL NOT NULL, edge_ids TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(origin,destination,boardings,rank))

name: historical_profiles
sql:
CREATE TABLE historical_profiles (
            pattern_id INTEGER, segment_index INTEGER, day_type TEXT,
            start_second INTEGER, end_second INTEGER, speed_kmh REAL,
            source TEXT NOT NULL, samples INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(pattern_id,segment_index,day_type,start_second))

name: historical_days
sql: CREATE TABLE historical_days (date TEXT PRIMARY KEY, day_type TEXT NOT NULL)

name: connection_operational_mappings
sql:
CREATE TABLE connection_operational_mappings (
            pattern_id INTEGER, stop_id TEXT, api_line INTEGER, api_stop INTEGER,
            checked_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(pattern_id,stop_id))

name: connection_segments
sql:
CREATE TABLE connection_segments (
            pattern_id INTEGER, segment_index INTEGER, origin TEXT, destination TEXT,
            distance_meters REAL, PRIMARY KEY(pattern_id,segment_index))
